text: Routing models usually find either fastest cheapest route. Accounting time monetary cost hard, minimizing trip duration minimizing cost competing objectives (Conway Stewart 2019). address problem, r5r’s pareto_frontier() returns efficient combinations travel time monetary cost origin/destination pairs. vignette shows, reproducible example, use interpret results.

title: Trade-offs between travel time and monetary cost
text: Imagine trip B several route alternatives (figure ): Walking cheapest option takes 50 minutes. Bus + subway fastest: 15 minutes R$ 8. single bus: R$ 3, 35 min; two buses one transfer: R$ 5, 29 min; walking subway: R$ 6, 20 min. options form Pareto frontier routes B: route faster cheaper route frontier. frontier, trip made faster without costing , cheaper without taking longer.   frontier shows time-cost trade-offs public transport passengers face. also supports cumulative-opportunity accessibility metrics time cost cutoffs (e.g. number jobs reachable within 40 minutes R$ 5) (Conway Stewart 2019). what: 2. How the time_window works and how to interpret the results.
title: Using the time_window parameter
text: time_window, R5 computes estimate departure every minute departure_datetime end window. GTFS feeds frequencies.txt table, draws_per_minute sets number Monte Carlo draws per minute (default 5, .e. 300 draws 60-minute window); without frequencies, departures deterministic draws_per_minute affect results. effect number draws result stability, see Stewart et al (2022). holds default routing algorithm (FastRaptor). fare_structure passed travel_time_matrix(), accessibility() travel_time_surface(), always pareto_frontier(), detailed_itineraries() shortest_path = FALSE, R5 uses McRaptor algorithm instead. McRaptor route departure every minute: routes time_window * draws_per_minute departure times sampled random within window (consecutive departures , average, 1 / draws_per_minute minutes apart, origin gets departure times, ones every call origin seed). McRaptor, draws_per_minute affects results even GTFS feeds frequencies.txt table. pareto_frontier() detailed_itineraries() fix 1. result single estimate distribution reflecting uncertainty within window. percentiles parameter selects percentiles return. example, 25th-percentile travel time 15 minutes B means 25% trips departing within window shorter 15 minutes.

One step, exponential, fixed_exponential, linear logistic. Defaults step, equivalent cumulative opportunities measure. Defaults WALK. See details options. mode_egress character vector. transport mode used egress last public transport. can either WALK, BICYCLE CAR. Defaults WALK. Ignored public transport used. departure_datetime POSIXct object. affects public transport legs; routing public transport, must fall within service period GTFS feeds (calendar.txt; see check_transit_availability()). Defaults Sys.time(). See details datetimes parsed. time_window integer. time window minutes r5r calculate multiple itineraries. Defaults 10. Unlike routing functions, results aggregated percentile, output may contain trips departing departure_datetime within window. shortest_path = TRUE fare_structure, trip routed minute departure_datetime time_window minutes later, fastest one returned (ties go earliest departure). Otherwise, departures simulated random seconds, one per minute (30 90 seconds apart), departure times every call origin, departure routed separately: itinerary may appear disappear departure_datetime changes one minute, sequence routes appears several departures, fastest kept. See vignette("time_window", package = "r5r"). suboptimal_minutes number. many minutes optimal arrival non-optimal McRAPTOR branch may arrive still kept (e.g. 10, routes arriving 10 minutes fastest one considered). can used shortest_path = FALSE fare_structure NULL. comparison made separately departure within time_window uses arrival time : route beyond margin discarded even fewer transfers. default, 0, keeps routes arriving earliest time departure. Higher values return itineraries, emulating people take slower route practical reasons (e.g. mode preference, safety). max_walk_time integer. maximum walking time (minutes) access egress transit network, make transfers, complete walk-trips. Applies leg separately (e.g. 15 allows 15 minutes reach transit another 15 leaving ). Defaults Inf (limit besides max_trip_duration). walk-trips, lower max_walk_time max_trip_duration applies. max_bike_time integer. maximum cycling time (minutes) access egress transit network, make transfers, complete bicycle-trips. Applies leg separately (e.g. 15 allows 15 minutes reach transit another 15 leaving ). Defaults Inf (limit besides max_trip_duration). bicycle-trips, lower max_bike_time max_trip_duration applies. max_car_time integer. maximum driving time (minutes) access egress transit network, complete car-trips. Applies leg separately (e.g. 15 allows 15 minutes reach transit another 15 leaving ). Defaults Inf (limit besides max_trip_duration). car-trips, lower max_car_time max_trip_duration applies. max_trip_duration integer. maximum trip duration minutes. Defaults 120. walk_speed numeric. Average walk speed km/h. Defaults 3.6. bike_speed numeric. Average cycling speed km/h. Defaults 12. max_rides integer. maximum number public transport rides allowed trip. Defaults 3. max_lts integer 1 4. maximum level traffic stress cyclists tolerate. value 1 means cyclists travel quietest streets, value 4 indicates cyclists can travel road. Defaults 2. See details. shortest_path logical. Without fare_structure, public transport trips routed R5's RAPTOR algorithm, much faster McRAPTOR algorithm used alternative routes fares (see Fastest itinerary section). all_to_all logical. Whether query routes 1st origin 1st destination, 2nd origin 2nd destination, (FALSE, default) query routes origins destinations (TRUE). shortest_path = TRUE fare_structure, all_to_all = TRUE runs one public transport search per origin destinations, much faster listing pairs all_to_all = FALSE. fare_structure fare structure object, following convention set setup_fare_structure(). object describes transit fares calculated. Defaults Inf (limit). finite value requires fare_structure; error raised otherwise. new_carspeeds data.frame specifying new car speed OSM edge id. table must contain columns osm_id, max_speed speed_type. Defaults 1, keeps speeds unlisted roads unchanged. new_lts data.frame specifying new LTS levels OSM edge id. table must contain columns osm_id lts. Alternatively, new_lts parameter can receive sf data.frame LINESTRING geometry. R5 find nearest road LINESTRING update LTS value accordingly. n_threads integer. number threads use running router parallel. Defaults Inf (available threads). verbose logical. Whether show R5 informative messages running function. Defaults FALSE (R5 error messages still shown). TRUE shows detailed output, useful debugging issues caught r5r. progress logical. Whether show progress counter running router. Defaults TRUE. works verbose FALSE. May slightly slow computation, counter synchronized across threads. drop_geometry logical. See info LTS original documentation R5 Conveyal https://docs.conveyal.com/learn-/traffic-stress. summary: LTS 1: Tolerable children. includes low-speed, low-volume streets, well separated bicycle facilities (parking-protected lanes cycle tracks). LTS 3: Tolerable "enthused confident" cyclists. includes streets may involve close proximity moderate- high-speed vehicular traffic.
